note: Vendored dependencies for hermitstash-sync. Zero npm runtime packages. blamejs is the single upstream source — the sync client now consumes blamejs's hardened wire-layer primitives (b.wsClient for the outbound WebSocket, b.safeJson for size/depth-capped JSON parsing) plus the noble-* CJS bundles blamejs itself vendors for the HermitStash-specific ECIES bootstrap.

consumed: vendor/blamejs/lib/ws-client.js — b.wsClient (outbound RFC 6455 client with decompression-bomb defence, UTF-8 fatal validation, control-frame caps, RSV1-on-cont reject, permanent-error classifier, TLSv1.3 pin, custom handshakeGuid)
vendor/blamejs/lib/safe-json.js — b.safeJson.parse (size + depth + prototype-pollution caps on untrusted server responses)
vendor/blamejs/lib/vendor/noble-ciphers.cjs#xchacha20poly1305 — symmetric AEAD for the HermitStash ECIES session key
vendor/blamejs/lib/vendor/noble-post-quantum.cjs#ml_kem1024 — KEM leg of the HermitStash hybrid ECIES bootstrap
